title: Learning to Agree under Pseudo-Reciprocity
abstract: arXiv:2608.22234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We characterize the communication networks that ensure consensus in rational social learning under the sure-thing principle. A network ensures consensus if and only if it is pseudo-reciprocal, a property under which reciprocity may fail between individuals but holds at a coarser group level. Prior work has assumed message exchange to be bidirectional, yet such pairwise reciprocity proves largely dispensable. We show that a single bidirectional link can suffice, however large the population.

translated_title: 在伪互惠条件下学习达成共识
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22234v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们刻画了在“确定事物原则”下，确保理性社会学习中达成共识的通信网络。一个网络能确保共识，当且仅当它是伪互惠的，这一性质允许个体间的互惠可能失效，但在更粗粒度的群体层面上仍然成立。先前的研究假设信息交换是双向的，然而这种成对互惠在很大程度上并非必要。我们证明，无论群体规模多大，单个双向链接就可能足以确保共识。
tldr: 本文揭示了在理性社会学习中，确保共识的网络只需具备伪互惠性，且单个双向链接即可在任意大规模群体中实现共识，挑战了传统双向互惠的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that consensus in rational social learning only requires pseudo-reciprocal networks, and a single bidirectional link suffices for any population size, challenging the necessity of pairwise reciprocity.
